label_quality_diagnostics.interpretation: The dual-year rule may exclude an observed change because its target label has a low Dynamic World quality-proxy value. The preceding-year-only variant is reported to expose that selection effect, not to rescue or validate model skill.
label_quality_diagnostics.purpose: Label-quality and selection-effect diagnostics only; neither filtered subset is an independent validation set or a model-skill test.

matched_input_diagnostic.interpretation: The macOS arm64 seed-31 run did not collapse, but it is not treated as a valid point estimate because independent external Windows x86_64 verification collapsed for all three seeds. Across the six platform-seed runs, five were zero-change outputs.
matched_input_diagnostic.training_target_boundary: same-year label suitability; not next-state transition learning

neighbourhood_input_diagnostic.interpretation: All three macOS arm64 seeds produced changes, but each underfilled the requested demand in both target years. This mode remains a mechanism diagnostic, not a comparable headline estimator.
